title: NFL owners unanimously approve $9.612 billion Seahawks sale to Khosla family
dek: NFL owners voted unanimously Wednesday to ratify the $9.612 billion sale of the Seahawks to a group led by Vinod Khosla's family, ending nearly three decades of Paul Allen family ownership. The deal is expected to close in September. The sale price is a league record, 59 percent higher than the previous high set by the Commanders sale in 2023.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: NFL owners unanimously ratified the league-record $9.612 billion sale of the Seahawks to the Khosla family, transferring ownership from the Paul Allen estate after 29 years.
bottom_line: The Khosla family must divest its 49ers minority stake before or shortly after taking control of the Seahawks. Monitor the timeline and terms of that divestment: complications in that process could delay the deal's close or signal friction within the new ownership structure.
body:
NFL team owners voted unanimously Wednesday to ratify the $9.612 billion sale of the Seahawks to a group led by the family of venture capitalist Vinod Khosla, according to Front Office Sports. The vote took place during a special one-day league meeting at an Atlanta airport hotel. The sale price sets a new NFL record, surpassing the $6.05 billion that a group led by private equity investor Josh Harris paid for the Commanders in 2023, a 59 percent increase.
Neeru Khosla, Vinod Khosla's wife, will serve as the Seahawks' controlling owner. Their son Neal Khosla is to have a role in ownership. The deal is expected to close in September 2026. Vinod Khosla, 71, co-founded Sun Microsystems and founded Khosla Ventures. Forbes estimates his net worth at $13.4 billion.
The sale ends nearly three decades of Paul Allen family ownership. Paul Allen purchased an option to buy the franchise in 1996 and completed the $194 million acquisition in 1997. After Allen died in 2018, he directed in his estate that the Seahawks and his NBA team, the Trail Blazers, be sold and the proceeds donated to charity. Jody Allen, his sister, served as de facto owner as trustee of his trust. , managed by investment bank Allen & Company and law firm Latham & Watkins.
The Seahawks are the reigning Super Bowl champions and are led on the football-operations side by John Schneider and coached by Mike Macdonald, per Front Office Sports. The franchise is scheduled to host the season-opening game September 9 against the Patriots at Lumen Field.
One ownership constraint looms: the Khosla family holds a minority stake in the San Francisco 49ers and must divest itself of that interest under NFL rules. NFL ownership rules stipulate that an ownership group can contain no more than 25 investors and the principal owner must hold at least a 30 percent stake.
